svg.aria-label: I build websites and web applications with React, JavaScript, HTML and CSS — not only interfaces, but also the server side, databases, APIs and deployment. I develop and integrate AI chats into websites, connect language models and set up integrations with external services. I also build Telegram apps, automated pipelines and tools for clients' needs. My main project is SONYA, a platform for automated video processing with computer vision, speech recognition and LLMs. Alongside it, I'm studying modern C++, systems programming and performance optimization.
